caseData.headline: Likely: bad loans are being reported as good ones

findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones

signals.explanation: Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 4 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
6 loans' credit scores at origination were rewritten after the fact, from below the 600 eligibility line to above it
Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0111 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (high confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 4 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0111-TARGETED_SOURCE_MISMATCH-1408ccc1]
  - 8 loans' credit scores at origination were rewritten after the fact, from below the 600 eligibility line to above it [ref S2-B0111-ATTRIBUTE_REWRITE-0509315e]
  - Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported [ref S1-B0111-PLEDGECHECK_COMPLETENESS_FAIL-dc756722]

Due: 2026-09-15 · Requires approval before it is carried out.

DRAFT LETTER — Schedule a field exam with screen-level source review
To: Borrower B0111, attention: Chief Financial Officer
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0111)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 4 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0111-TARGETED_SOURCE_MISMATCH-1408ccc1]
  - 8 loans' credit scores at origination were rewritten after the fact, from below the 600 eligibility line to above it [ref S2-B0111-ATTRIBUTE_REWRITE-0509315e]
  - Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported [ref S1-B0111-PLEDGECHECK_COMPLETENESS_FAIL-dc756722]

Please provide access, within the audit rights of the credit agreement, to the servicing system so our examiners can review the listed loans on screen by 2026-09-19.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
